sum: Punjab National Bank files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition of shares in listed subsidiary PNB Housing Finance Limited. Filing triggers mandatory takeover regulations requiring public disclosure of acquirer identity, shareholding, and acquisition terms.
detail: PNB submitted formal disclosure to NSE under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011 Regulation 31(4), which mandates disclosure within 2 working days of crossing prescribed shareholding thresholds. The disclosure requirement indicates PNB acquired or announced intention to acquire shares in PNB Housing Finance, a listed housing finance entity. Depending on the quantum acquired, this may trigger mandatory open offer at the specified acquisition price, with implications for minority shareholders and potential delisting proceedings.
